name: 2019 NYC School Survey - Student
description: This dataset contains student-level results from the 2019 NYC School Survey, covering about 1,800 sampled records from New York City public schools. Each row identifies a school by its DBN code and name and reports parent, teacher, and student response rates along with survey-based scores for collaborative teachers, effective school leadership, rigorous instruction, supportive environment, strong family-community ties, and trust. Scores generally range from 1 to 5, with higher values indicating more favorable conditions. The supportive environment score is entirely missing, and several other score columns have moderate missingness, so analyses should account for incomplete records. The student response rate column is stored as text with percent signs and appears to be scaled by a factor of 100, so it needs cleaning before use. The dataset supports comparing schools across survey dimensions, examining links between response rates and reported school quality, identifying schools with strong or weak family-community engagement, and research or reporting on school climate and improvement efforts.
